build: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/data/asyncfuse/target-workspace CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo build --workspace --features workspace-overlay -j 2

trial_order: off, on, JuiceFS; initial JuiceFS trials excluded because an external grep read .accesslog; clean JuiceFS replay after guardrails
